name: bw_three
prompt:
A clear BLACK-AND-WHITE flat-vector diagram for a Chinese report, organised in THREE horizontal bands so a non-specialist can read it top to bottom. STRICTLY MONOCHROME: only pure black, white and one light gray. No color at all. LANDSCAPE orientation, wider than tall, about 3:2. Pure white background. Bold crisp Chinese sans-serif typography, generously spaced, nothing crowded. Thin precise black rules, no shadows, no gradients.

On the FAR LEFT edge, three small solid BLACK label tabs, one vertically centered on each band, each with WHITE Chinese text: 有什么用 / 怎么实现 / 怎么建

BAND 1 (top) — three equal WHITE boxes side by side with THICK black outlines. Each has a solid BLACK header strip with LARGE WHITE Chinese text, and below it one line of black Chinese text:
Box 1 header 溯源检索 , line 找得到材料 条条有出处
Box 2 header 学术助研 , line 看得清缺口 理得出命题
Box 3 header 教材评价与合规审查 , line 评得了质量 查得出风险

BAND 2 (middle) — three WHITE boxes with THIN black outlines, each aligned directly under the box above it, each holding three short black Chinese lines with small black square bullets:
Box 1: 材料库收四类材料 / 按学科 学段 类型归类 / 出处字段必填
Box 2: 八格标签体系 / 覆盖度自动统计 / 政策 学术 史料三栏检索
Box 3: 六维观测要素 / 双人标注算一致性 / 规范表述比对与七类风险清单
Draw a THICK BLACK upward arrow from each BAND 2 box into the BAND 1 box above it.

BAND 3 (bottom) — a LIGHT GRAY strip spanning the full width, containing a left-to-right chain of four WHITE boxes with thin black outlines joined by THICK BLACK right-pointing arrows. Each box has a small black circled number, a bold black Chinese title and one smaller black Chinese line:
Box 1 number 1, title 搭系统 , line 人工智能学院开发 复用校内服务器
Box 2 number 2, title 建材料库 , line 三院师生标注 学生初标 教师确认
Box 3 number 3, title 上功能 , line 六个月核心 一年全部建成
Box 4 number 4, title 交运营 , line 结项后教务处承接
Below this chain, inside the same gray strip, one line of bold black Chinese text: 经费 8 万元　学校专项
